capabilities: display a reading progress bar in the status bar
toggle a full-screen button in the status bar
show the current view type indicator
configure progress bar length and animations
support progress tracking for markdown, pdf, search, thino, and bases views
extras: Desktop-only; the README warns not to use it on mobile. Views with infinite scrolling such as canvas cannot be tracked, so the bar turns gray for unsupported view types.
motivation: The author adapted the plugin for the view types they commonly use and invites requests for more.
problem: Obsidian's status bar does not show how far you have scrolled in a view, which matters when reading long markdown or PDF documents.

relations.evidence: Currently supported view types include: markdown, pdf, search, thino, and bases.

summary: Status bar plugin that shows a reading progress bar, full-screen button, and current view type indicator on desktop.
